notes.title: New Song by DeLe-GT Available Now!
notes.content:
[h1]The underground is alive and it just got louder! 
[/h1][p]We’re excited to announce that [b]DeLe[/b]-[b]GT[/b], one of the most powerful voices of the scene, joins [i]ANTRO[/i] with a brand new exclusive track. This fresh addition brings new energy to your journey through [i]ANTRO[/i], blending the intense platforming and storytelling with beats that hit harder than ever.

[b]DeLe-GT’s[/b] new track is more than just music. It’s a pulse that drives the rebellion forward. Whether you’re running through collapsing tunnels or facing the oppressive Regime, this new song will keep your heart pounding. 
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281754/163c275703f75dc986c0344dd6bf447b2b6471b0.png"][/img][/p][p]
And the best part? It’s available today. Jump back in, turn up the volume, and let the underground shake your speakers.  [/p][p][/p][p]Want to enjoy [i]Antro’s[/i] soundtrack outside the game? We’ve got you covered! Starting today, you can grab the brand new [i]ANTRO[/i] Game + Music Bundle, giving you both the full game and its powerful soundtrack together at a special price. [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1861250/Antro/"][/dynamiclink]
[/p]

notes.title: ANTRO is now available.
notes.content:
[h1][b]ANTRO is now available[/b][/h1][p][/p][h2]After years of hard work, we can finally say it: [b]ANTRO is now available![/b][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281754/fc48fbc6a398a0e9d6c233622e86075f5c568fc7.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]It’s been a long road, full of effort. From the very first sketches to seeing the game in your hands, there have been tough moments, many sleepless nights, and above all, an incredible amount of love poured into this project.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you to everyone who’s been with us from the beginning. To those who played the demo, sent us messages, streamed the game, or simply waited with excitement — this launch is yours too.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]What is ANTRO?[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]ANTRO is a rhythm-action platformer set in a dystopian underground world.
But it’s more than that — it’s a statement against the system, a story of rebellion, rhythm, and survival.[/p][p]Here are some of its main features:[/p][list][*][p]Rhythm-based platforming through unique environments.[/p][/*][*][p]A dystopian underground society divided by class, brought to life with a striking visual and audio style.[/p][/*][*][p]An original soundtrack blending rap, techno, and other urban genres, fully synchronized with each level.[/p][/*][*][p]A story of resistance and freedom told through rhythm and movement.[/p][/*][*][p]Available in multiple languages, fully localized.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Where to play:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Now available on Steam.[/p][/*][*][p]Available digitally on PS5 and Xbox Series.[/p][/*][*][p]You can also pre-order the physical PS5 edition, featuring exclusive content for collectors.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you, truly, for believing in us.[/p][p]Now it’s your turn: fight with rhythm, break the system, and escape ANTRO.[/p][p]See you on the other side.[/p][p][/p][h3]— [i]The Gatera Studios Team[/i][/h3]

notes.title: Release Date Confirmed! ANTRO arrives on June 27.
notes.content:
The wait is over! ANTRO, the rhythm-based action-platformer set in a dystopian underground world, will be released on June 27, 2025. The news was revealed with an exclusive trailer at the Future Games Show.

[previewyoutube=GHMVT22DfbY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]A Must-Have Physical Edition[/h2]

For collectors (and those with great taste), the physical edition of ANTRO is now available for pre-order. This edition includes:

[list]
[*] The full game in physical format (PS5 / Nintendo Switch)
[*] An exclusive artbook featuring designs from ANTRO's underground universe
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281754/8ab80135d36ab134e582abb894a0ada7ca075c89.png[/img]

[h2]Haven’t Tried It Yet?[/h2]

The ANTRO demo is still available on both Steam and PlayStation. If you haven't yet dived into this world of rhythm, rebellion, and neon... what are you waiting for?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281754/ecf0861fd41da09e4cb0d4c6fdbcb27d713de256.gif[/img]

[h3]Get ready to break through the system to the beat. ANTRO arrives on June 27.[/h3]

notes.title: ANTRO DEMO UPDATES WITH ASIAN LANGUAGE SUPPORT!
notes.content:

We’ve rolled out a update to the ANTRO Demo – [b]now fully localized in Asian languages[/b]! Dive into the rhythm-driven chaos and experience the enhanced version of what ANTRO has to offer, with [b]Japanese, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese[/b] languages now integrated.

This update retains everything you love: [b]music-synced combat[/b] in dystopian beats, [b]three explosive stages and OST tracks[/b] crafted exclusively for the game, and the [b]rebellious pulse of fighting oppressive regimes[/b]. notes.title: 🎵 Antro Announces Physical Edition for PS5 Alongside Digital Release on Steam
notes.content:
[h3]Antro Confirms Physical Edition for PlayStation 5 Alongside Digital Launch on PC and Consoles![/h3]

Antro is making noise this year! Along with the digital launch on Steam, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S, SelectaPlay and Gatera Studio have confirmed that Antro will have a physical edition for PlayStation 5, including an exclusive artbook with stunning illustrations from the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281754/c0ce7117b155c34a9406e852707daaa2e369f680.png[/img]

After The Collapse, humanity now survives in an underground city ruled by The Dome, a totalitarian regime that has banned music and art. In Antro, you’ll join Nittch on what seems like a simple mission: deliver a package. But the journey will be packed with obstacles, platforming, parkour, and high-speed chases – all to the rhythm of hip hop, drill, R&B, and electronic music.

Are you ready to join The Discordants and defy the system?

🎵 Don’t forget – you can try the free demo on Steam and add the game to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1861250/Antro/

notes.title: ANTRO: An Underground Revolution Unfolds at Save & Sound festival
notes.content:
[h3]Step into the depths of ANTRO, an underground world forged beneath the ruins of Barcelona following the Collapse. [/h3]

As Nittch, a solitary delivery man, you'll navigate the complex layers of ANTRO. The journey is fraught with challenges, from solving intricate puzzles to performing mechanics. The ever-present threat of pursuit means you must always be ready to run, with the game's rhythm-driven mechanics ensuring that both you and the environment move in harmony with the music.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281754/2fa7845ed05406c6cebd7d2deebc9e7aadb63a3a.png[/img]

Music is not just a backdrop but a driving force in ANTRO, with tracks spanning Hip Hop, Drill, R&B, and electronic genres, each enhancing the emotional and narrative depth of your journey. Every level's soundtrack is carefully crafted to reflect the tension and excitement of the adventure, making sound an integral part of the gameplay experience.

Join the rebellion of Los Discordantes as you navigate this dystopian world, aiming to disrupt the technological overproduction and censorship imposed by La Cúpula. The stakes are high, and the future of ANTRO rests on your shoulders.
[b][h3]
Experience ANTRO firsthand by trying out the demo available on Steam during the Save & Sound festival until November 7th. Don't forget to add ANTRO to your wishlists on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1861250/Antro/]Steam[/url] and [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10011682]PS5[/url]![/h3][/b]

notes.title: Gatera Studio Joins Forces with Selecta Play to amplify Antro`s Rythm
notes.content:
[h3][b]We signed a publishing deal with Selecta Play:[/b][/h3]

After 4 years of blood, sweat and development, ANTRO will be released for Steam, [url=https://store.playstation.com/concept/10011682]PlayStation5[/url], Xbox Series S|X and Epic Games Store across North American and European digital stores in 2025. 

[previewyoutube=MvYX9qpAv5o;full][/previewyoutube]

“The exciting blend of action, puzzles and platforming with urban music makes for a really thrilling gameplay experience, so for us, ANTRO was a title we really wanted to help bring to market.” commented Javi Puertas, Head of Gaming at SelectaPlay “Working with the talented team at Gatera Studio has been a great experience and we can’t wait to share more news on the release of Antro in the coming weeks.”

[h3][b]Two New Nominations for Antro:[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281754/689edc378d5d17a1abb8aa4cea26144deb7af4b6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281754/55db3c9f8f80a7ff9170c3ced3435ce9f33d6feb.png[/img]

We are also pleased to announce that yesterday Antro has been nominated in the "Best Sound" category at Game Connection X ChinaJoy 2024 and in the "Creator's Choice Nominees" category of the Indie Cup 2024.

There will be more news about Antro soon, for now, don't forget to add Antro to your Wishlist on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1861250/Antro/]Steam [/url]and [url=https://store.playstation.com/concept/10011682]PS5[/url].

notes.title: Save & Sound - A celebration of music in games is going live September 11 - 14!
notes.content:
[h2]Get ready![/h2]

Join us September 11 - 14 right here on Steam for one of the largest digital expos about audio and music in games. Save & Sound features concerts, deep-dives, and mashups from 70+ developers from around the world!

Starting at 10am PDT / 7pm CEST, a 3-day live show from September 11 - 13 will showcase original content made just for Save & Sound.

We will be participating in it on September 11th at 10am PDT / 7pm CEST, and you’ll be able to listen to a live set of urban music directly from ANTRO, our upcoming game about an underground revolution. Join Nittch and the Discordants in the race to overthrow La Cúpula. In our rhythm, action, puzzle and 2.5D platforming game, music will be your ally, just like in Save & Sound!

[h2]Don’t miss out on updates![/h2]

Set a reminder to be notified when Save & Sound will go live!

The show will be streamed on the Save & Sound website, YouTube, and Twitch. Check out all the games part of the event on [url=saveandsound.io]saveandsound.io[/url]

notes.title: Save & Sound - A celebration of music in games!
notes.content:
[h2]Get ready![/h2]

Join us July 14 - 18 right here on Steam for one of the largest digital expos about audio and music in games. Featuring concerts, deep-dives, and mashups from 70+ developers from around the world, prepare your eyes & ears for a unique event!

Starting at 10am PDT / 7pm CEST, a 4-day live show from July 14 to 17 will stream showcasing all the wonderful content made just for Save & Sound. 

ANTRO by Gatera Studio is a 2.5D Rhythm Puzzle Platformer game, set in an underground city in a post-apocalyptic future. ANTRO merge music and gameplay. Using a cleverly articulated potpourri of genres, including Hip Hop, Drill, R&B and Electronic music, the player will be able to identify situations and act upon them in sync with the music. In addition, the music not only conveys and accentuates the emotions, but also supports the narrative thread of the story.

[h2]Don’t miss out on updates![/h2]

Set a reminder to be notified when Save & Sound will go live!

The show will be streamed on the Save & Sound website. Check out all the games part of the event on [url=saveandsound.io]saveandsound.io[/url]
